author: gpt-5.6-luna
brief: A negative control: a small, clear task on an existing repository (the background worker in fixture/) that needs no special method. Pick one existing setting in the worker's config file and ask to rename it to a clearer name you choose, across code, config and docs, while the old name still works as an alias for one release and logs a single deprecation warning when used. State both names in the request. Hidden tests load the config with the new name, the old name and both (the new one wins).
